name: Lo Debar
overview: Lo Debar is identified as a city within the territory of the tribe of Manasseh, specifically noted as the home of Mephibosheth, the lame son of Jonathan. In 2 Samuel 9:3-5, King David inquires about any surviving members of Saul's house to extend God's kindness and is informed that Mephibosheth resides in Lo Debar, in the house of Machir. This setting underscores God's providential care and David's covenant faithfulness in restoring kindness to Jonathan's family, even from a remote and humble location.
